QUOTE: "`ExternalBridge::accept_loop` (`src/facade/external_bridge.cpp:796`, started by `ExternalBridge::start`) uses `poll()` with a 500ms timeout so it can see shutdown. Each accepted client gets its own thread, which is stored in `client_threads_`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that an accept loop thread spawns a separate thread per accepted client (serve_client), giving the two-level structure.
